    """Return the nth Fibonacci number (1-indexed)."""
    if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be a positive integer")
    if n == 1 or n == 2:
        return 1
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)

        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")
